verdict.rationale: Unit's own docs say its APIs expose transaction data for accounts and cards, with real-time balances and settlement-level visibility across ACH, wires, RTP, checks and international payments. That loosely implies rail-aware transaction records. Nothing in the pack describes the depth of those records, and with no OpenAPI spec available the field-level content can't be verified. Missing for 10: documented counterparty details, explicit rail-specific metadata fields, stable transaction identifiers, merchant/category enrichment, a field-level schema, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
